, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER 1.
The lands of the petitioner have been acquired by the State for the purposes of Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board (for short, 'the KIADB').
They are acquired by way of a preliminary notification dated 08.02.2010 and a final notification dated 26.05.2012.
A General Award was passed on 24.06.2017 in respect of the lands acquired.
Aggrieved by the same, the petitioner preferred W.P.No.9898/2020 (LA-KIADB)
and at his instance, the KIADB was directed to pass a Consent Award under Section 29(2) of the KIAD Act.
Pursuant to the order of this Court in W.P.No.9898/2020 (LA-KIADB), an agreement was entered into with the petitioner on 12.05.2022 and a Consent Award was passed accordingly.
The petitioner accepted the compensation without any protest.

Thereafter, he has filed the instant writ petition on the ground that the compensation has been awarded to him as per the provisions of the Old Land Acquisition Act and is not based on the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
